name: @memtro/cli
description: The memtro command: your company's memory, its connected systems and its agent, from a terminal or a script.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { chmodSync } from 'node:fs'; chmodSync('dist/main.js', 0o755)"
